$comment: What changed between two models, as both the engine (ModelDiff.cs) and the client (modelDiff.ts) must say it (ADR-0031). Models are in the shape the API sends. Changes are listed in the order both report them: additions and changes in the order of the later model, then removals in the order of the earlier one.

a rename and a move are one change to one element
additions and removals, of elements and links
a reversed link is the same link, now from and to the other ends
an end moved to an element that is new is named from the model it is in
technology and description, on containers, systems, people and flows
